def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue

            # Treat each separate same-colored object independently.
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                component.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1, cc), (rr+1, cc), (rr, cc-1), (rr, cc+1)):
                    if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and
                        (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color):
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))

            r0 = min(rr for rr, cc in component)
            r1 = max(rr for rr, cc in component)
            c0 = min(cc for rr, cc in component)
            c1 = max(cc for rr, cc in component)

            # Fill the interior of rectangular outlines. The fill alternates
            # according to the interior width: odd widths use 7, even widths use 2.
            if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
                continue
            if not (all(grid[r0][cc] == color and grid[r1][cc] == color
                        for cc in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                    all(grid[rr][c0] == color and grid[rr][c1] == color
                        for rr in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
                continue

            inner_h, inner_w = r1 - r0 - 1, c1 - c0 - 1
            fill = 7 if inner_w % 2 else 2
            for rr in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                for cc in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    out[rr][cc] = fill

    # A 3x3 ring marker indicates a 7 in its center.
    for color in counts:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1 - r0 == 2 and c1 - c0 == 2:
            if (grid[r0][c0] == color and grid[r0][c1] == color and
                grid[r1][c0] == color and grid[r1][c1] == color and
                grid[r0][c0+1] == color and grid[r1][c0+1] == color and
                grid[r0+1][c0] == color and grid[r0+1][c1] == color):
                out[r0+1][c0+1] = 7

    return out
